chapter.heading: A Song of Praise for the Lord’s Faithfulness to His PeopleA Psalm of Thanksgiving.
chapter.v:
Make a
joyful shout to the Lord, all you lands! [Neh. 11:1; Is. 48:2; 64:10; Zech. 14:20, 21; Matt. 4:5; [Rev. 21:2-27]]

Serve the
Lord with gladness;Come before His presence with singing. [Is. 9:4; 10:27; 14:25; Zech. 2:7]

Know that
the Lord, He is God;It is He who has made us, and not we ourselves;We are His people and the sheep of His pasture. [Ps. 44:12; Jer. 15:13 e Is. 45:13]

Enter into
His gates with thanksgiving,And into His courts with praise.Be thankful to Him, and bless His name. [Gen. 46:6 1 As]

For the
Lord is good;His mercy is everlasting,And His truth endures to all generations. [Ezek. 36:20, 23; Rom. 2:24 2 DSS]
